title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
reason: Official confirmation of a CEO transition at the company central to AI infrastructure is frontier-shifting.

title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang resigns, chipmaker names CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO
reason: Confirmed resignation of Nvidia's CEO with a named interim successor across two sources is market-moving for AI and crypto alike.

sources.summary: Nvidia gets a new chief executive, days after former CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a romantic affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
